suggested_change: Criteria 2, 4, 5 are appropriate but CLAUDE.md lacks explicit rules for: (1) marking incomplete transcripts with 'no new information' statements per component, (2) enforcing specific actor-action format ('Ask [person] on next call:') vs vague verbs like 'Follow up', (3) validating date references against deal timeline. Criterion 3 should explicitly require ICP fit assessment based on company profile signals (user count, tech stack, product priorities).
